retrievalProfile.description: A 1970s-style band portrait featuring pinstriped suits and a gritty urban brick background with high-contrast display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four men in 1920s-style pinstripe suits and white ties, posing with vintage props against a weathered red brick wall and industrial debris.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group positioned behind a low brick wall
High-contrast black typography centered at the top
Informational sticker-style box in the upper right corner
Torn paper texture overlay at the bottom edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Mid-ground group portrait, subjects occupy the central horizontal band of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure leaning on a rusted metal barrel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold title at the top, down to the central figures, then to the informational box on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture and subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated brick red and earthy browns in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the pinstripe suits.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for ties and the informational sticker background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between the dark suits and light accents.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and monochromatic tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight slab serif and high-contrast transitional serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Thick, blocky serifs for the main title
High stroke contrast for secondary text
Tight letter spacing in the display title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Slightly distressed edges on the main title to match the gritty background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for branding paired with high-contrast transitional serifs for information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky slab serif of the main title.
Matches the high-contrast serif used in the informational box.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of four men in 1920s pinstripe suits posing behind a low brick wall in a gritty urban setting with a torn paper texture at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a heavy black slab-serif title at the top center and a white rectangular box with red and black serif text in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Title is in a heavy slab-serif font
Background is a weathered brick wall

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the torn paper effect looks organic
Confirm the sticker box is correctly positioned
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1920s gangster fashion] with [1970s album photography] using [heavy slab-serif typography] and [weathered urban textures].
